note: Public Ledger settings. Everything in this file is safe to publish.
articlePageLinksNote: When true, scripts/build_published.py adds a Research Ledger link to each essay page. It is off until the owner approves changing the published essay pages. Correction notices on essay pages do not depend on this switch: they appear only for an approved, prominent correction.

concernChannels.endpointNote: No secure submission service exists yet, so the Ledger cannot receive reports. It says so on the page.

githubIssues.note: Public. Switch on only with the owner's approval; anything sent there is visible to everyone.
